tha-ap263:4.1: chattiṁsakappamhi → battiṁsakappamhi (bj, sya-all, pts) | battiṁsakappamhi → chattiṁsakappamhi (bj: machasaṁ) | battiṁsakappamhi → G. chattiṁse-. (pts note)
tha-ap263:4.3: antalikkhakaro → antalikkhacaro (bj, pts) | antalikkhacaro → antalikkhakaro (bj: machasaṁ) | Antalikkhacaro → S2 antalikkhe-. (pts note)
